goal: Align GitHub Initiative acceptance summary validation with the canonical TaskIntent assertion contract so assertions from 501 through 2,000 characters publish losslessly, while preserving restricted-text checks, the 65,536-byte Issue body preflight, terminal-suffix reserve, and zero GitHub mutations on rejected bodies.

acceptance.assertion: A Git-tracked canonical TaskIntent whose acceptance assertion is between 501 and 2,000 characters passes GitHub tracker upsert validation and complete Initiative publication without truncation; the rendered Child Issue contains the full assertion, while prohibited acceptance content continues to return permanent_failure before any GitHub mutation.

Acceptance summaries up to 2,000 characters remain subordinate to the existing 65,536-byte UTF-8 GitHub Issue body limit and reserved terminal suffix; a complete Initiative whose rendered Child body exceeds that byte budget returns permanent_failure with zero GitHub mutations.
